events.title: Gently Packed Has Found a Publisher!
events.summary: Hey everyone! We have some huge news to share today: our cozy cashier simulator, Gently Packed, has officially joined forces with Pixel Doors as our publisher! We’re beyond thrilled to team up with them. Together, we’re going to work on making store management and bag packing in Gently Packed even more satisfying, relaxing, and fun for all of you. events.title: Operational Independence - Update
events.summary: The Store, Inc. is pleased to announce that personnel are now trusted to manage their own inventory. This trust was not earned. It was reallocated, following a budget review that identified automatic restocking as a cost the corporation would prefer you absorb.The Warehouse Is Yours Now The warehouse is fully operational and entirely your concern. events.title: Controller Authorized - Update
events.summary: The Store, Inc. is pleased to announce that following 17 quarters of internal review, personnel are now authorized to operate franchise locations using a standard input controller. The decision was reached after the Ergonomics Subcommittee reviewed a series of incidents involving keyboards, wrists, and what one report described as "a sound the human hand should not produce." events.title: Demo Update: New Languages Added
events.summary: Hey everyone!Quick update - we've added 8 new languages to the Gently Packed demo!If you’ve already tried the demo, feel free to jump back in and check it out. And if you notice anything odd with the translations, please let us know using the in-game feedback option - it really helps us improve.Thanks again for all the support!

events.title: Gently Packed Demo Now Available
events.summary: Hey everyone! The Gently Packed demo is now live on Steam! We’re super excited to finally let you try the game and see how a day in Gently Packed plays out. The demo offers a small, cozy slice of the experience and is a great way to get a feel for the game. If you enjoy it, consider adding Gently Packed to your wishlist - it really helps us as a small team. We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback, so feel free to share them using the form: https://forms.gle/zFBNmw9YUVDLBqvn6 Thanks for play
